Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: ship and colony panel
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A small panel in the top-left corner with the ship's air, hull, heat and fuel, days of food, stored power, the temperature under the mouse and the full date.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: custom pawn table
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A main tab with a table of colonists where you pick the columns (needs, skills, speed) and sort by any of them.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: power tab
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A main tab listing every power net with production, use, balance and stored energy.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: gear tab
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A Gear tab on people with armor, insulation, vacuum protection, carried mass, weapon range, apparel condition and inventory.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: copy and paste bills
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Copy all bills of a workbench and paste them onto another workbench of the same kind.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: value and mass on items
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Shows the total value and mass of a stack when you select it.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: quality colors
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Item quality words get a color, from red for awful to gold for legendary.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: trait colors
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Good traits show in green and bad traits in red on the character card.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: damage numbers
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Shows floating numbers when people take damage.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: material count in build menu
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: The build menu shows how much of each needed material you have on the map.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: empty deep drill alert
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Warns when a deep drill has nothing left to dig.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: weapon range ring
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Draws the weapon range of selected drafted people.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: minimap
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A small draggable map of the current map. Click it to move the camera. Toggle with Ctrl+M.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: who hurt whom
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Corpses say who killed them and how, and you get a message when a colonist loses a body part and who did it.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: search
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Ctrl+F opens a search of items, people and buildings on the map and the bodies of the home system. Click a result to jump to it.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: low stored power alert
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Warns when a power net is losing power and its batteries are below 15%.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: pause on threats
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Pauses the game when a threat letter arrives.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: copy work settings
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Copy a colonist's work priorities, schedule and allowed area and paste them onto another.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: quick work modes
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Switch selected colonists to emergency, repair or hauling mode in one click, and restore their old priorities later.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: haul area
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: An order that marks every loose item in a dragged area for hauling.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: copy and paste buildings
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Copy the buildings in an area and paste them somewhere else as blueprints.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: select bed owner
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A button on beds that selects their owners.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: toggle harvest
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Pause and resume harvesting on growing zones and hydroponics.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: switch storage on and off
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Stockpiles and storage buildings can be switched off and on without losing their settings.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: smart medicine
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Minor wounds are treated with cheaper medicine when it is around, saving the good medicine for serious cases.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: search and destroy
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: A toggle on drafted colonists that makes them hunt the nearest enemy on their own.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: defensive positions
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Save a spot for a drafted colonist and send them back to it with one click.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: pick up dropped weapon
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Colonists who dropped their weapon when downed pick it up again when they get up.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: permanent enemies never flee
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Raiders from factions that are permanent enemies fight to the end instead of fleeing.

Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.label: trade drop spot
Rimverse.QolFeatureDef.description: Build a drop spot where orbital traders deliver goods.

MainButtonDef.label: power
MainButtonDef.description: Every power net on the map.

MainButtonDef.label: table
MainButtonDef.description: A table of colonists with the columns you choose.
